name: Nintendo Museum
intro: Nintendo's own museum in Uji, near Kyoto, showing the company's products over the years, with hands-on games. Tickets are given out by lottery, so you have to enter three months ahead and hope to win.

facts.bookAhead: Three months: enter the lottery three months before your visit

statusNote: Read from the official visit-flow page.
popularityNote: Keyword data (Oct 2025 to Sep 2026): "nintendo museum tickets" about 5,000 searches a month and rising; ranked below Pokémon Café, which has more related searches.
difficultyNote: Tickets are given out by lottery (official), so entering is no guarantee of a ticket; tickets freed after the lottery are sold first come, first served.
bookingSteps: Create a free Nintendo Account. You need it to enter the drawing and to buy tickets.
Enter the drawing on the official ticketing site, three months before your visit. Book in the name of the person visiting.
Wait for the results email, sent to your Nintendo Account address on the 1st of the following month.
If you win, pay by the 7th with a Visa, Mastercard or JCB card that has a security code and is registered for 3D Secure. Unpaid tickets are cancelled.
Buying for a group? Use Assign Ticket to give each person their own QR code. Each person needs their own Nintendo Account.
From 14:00 the day before your visit, issue your QR code on the ticketing site. After that, the ticket can't be cancelled.
At the security gate, show your QR code and your passport.
visitorTips: A passport is the only ID accepted from non-Japanese visitors. If your identity can't be checked, you may be refused entry.
Not selected? Tickets freed by cancellations may go on sale first come, first served after the drawing.
Workshops inside the museum are booked on the day, first come, first served, for an extra fee.

faq.q: How do I get Nintendo Museum tickets?
faq.a: Through a lottery that opens three months before your visit. Winners are emailed on the 1st of the next month and must pay by the 7th.

sources.quote: Entries will be accepted beginning three months prior to your visit.
